blocks.text: RCBC on Friday announced the passing of Mr. Cesar E.A. Virata, our Corporate Vice Chairperson/Director, today, October 2, 2026. Mr. Virata was a Director of RCBC since 1995 and has been the Board’s Corporate Vice Chairperson for 26 years, it said in a PSE disclosure.
